fit_side_length_why: proxy gate: side length / front height 0.891 vs the sheet's 0.800 (+11.4 %, the body too long): Y scaled x 0.898 to the sheet (orchestrator unit note). No refloor: the proxy's lowest point is already a hoof (front -x hoof z 0.000; the tail sits at z 3.3..4.9) and its height 6.579 u is the sheet front height 6.59 within 0.2 %

dense.why: the head / face: eyes, nose, muzzle, mouth line and the tall ears (proxy slabs: head x -1.15..0.54, y -2.63..-0.80, z 3.75..6.58 after the side-length fit)

light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low itself: the proxy's fur flaps (neck tuft, leg fringes) are inner shells that black-hole AO rays (crystal_canine / vulture_creature lesson)
light.ao_distance_why: only real crevices darken (the sheet's fur is light and flat: torso L* p10..p90 78.8..83.6). Run 1 at 0.6 u: AO took the fur basecolor median L* 78.6 -> 73.2 (p10 71.4 -> 57.3); 0.45 u keeps the leg / belly crevices and loses the broad darkening
light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner shells under the fur flaps) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight

recolour3d.name: belly_streak
recolour3d.why: the proxy painted the tail's dark blue as a streak along the belly underside midline (x -0.23..0.34, y -1.05..1.55, z 2.4..3.2; median 50..72, 74..101, 112..138): the sheet's belly is light fur; repainted the sheet back-view rump / underside fur (back view px 420..550 x 520..560, median 149,185,224)

recolour3d.name: rump_spine_smear
recolour3d.why: orchestrator: 'the back view has a dark smear down the spine from the tail colour': the dark runs from the tail down the rump to the crotch (z 2.8..3.2). The sheet back view's tail patch ends at px row 520 = z 3.06; below it light fur (back view median 149,185,224)

recolour3d.name: fur
recolour3d.why: orchestrator: the proxy texture reads grey-blue and darker than the sheet's light blue (chips 196,216,234 / 156,187,223): proxy fur median 164,192,221 (L* 76.7, p25..p75 68..83) vs the sheet fur (side torso 176,207,233, head 179,207,233, legs 166,199,230, chest 163,197,230; L* p10..p90 78.8..83.6). Fur texels (L* >= 45, b* <= -4: not the eyes / nose / hooves / tail / teal ear insides / mouth) to 184,212,238 with the proxy's shading kept at half contrast (gamma 0.5, clip 1.08 so the blue channel never saturates): set ~6 % above the sheet fur median so basecolor = albedo x AO lands on it (run 1: target 172,203,232 gave basecolor fur median 156,183,212). The tail tuft is excluded

recolour3d.name: tail_tuft
recolour3d.why: spec 'darker blue tail fur': the proxy's tail is near-navy (median 42,63,94, L* 26); the sheet's tail tuft (side view px 1080..1140 x 345..455, median 56,103,157; back view patch 57,103,160, L* 43). Second box: the rump just under the tail root (z 3.0..3.35), which the sheet back view draws as the bottom of the tail patch

recolour3d.name: hooves
recolour3d.why: the proxy's hooves are near-black navy (median 22,35,78, L* 14.6); the sheet's hooves are slate blue (side view px 720..800 x 770..810 median 68,91,126; front 56,76,104; chips 66,84,112 / 50,61,78)

yaw.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing'): best mirror plane per slab of the v1 low (yaw sweep, plane-x sweep): torso back z 3.4..4.1 x 0.02 yaw 1.0 (p99 0.135; at yaw 0 x 0.02), torso mid z 2.6..3.8 x 0.01 at yaw 0; face core x -0.16 yaw 0.0 (p99 0.041), snout x -0.15 yaw 1.0 (p99 0.035). The body is not turned, only 0.017 u off-centre (stage-1 frame): one rigid shift puts the torso plane on x 0; the rig / repose / focus below are in this frame

light.adds_why: the light remesh is a HOLLOW skin (stage-1 occupancy 2.9 %; the chest / belly are thin walls), so each cut leaves the leg tube's opening into the body: light.adds rebuilds the skin there (spike_beak v1.1 idiom): front, capsules r 0.05 along y -0.89..-0.56 at z 2.765 (x 0.02..0.40) joining the chest-bottom plate (z 2.74..2.78) and the chest front wall (y -0.94); hind, capsules r 0.06 sloping z 3.06 -> 2.90 along y 0.97 -> 1.58 (x -0.56..-0.20) joining the belly bottom (z 3.02..3.07), the flank (x -0.6) and the -x hind thigh's front wall. Kept inside the old opening (run 2's wider patch, y to -1.0 / x to -0.64, stuck out as a ledge under the chest). Offline hole test on the grid: every column under the removed legs' tops first hits skin at z <= 2.78 (front) / 2.98 (hind); one main piece + crumbs <= 180 nodes (dropped as specks)

chains.name: arm
chains.why: v2, shifted frame, the KEPT front legs (the +x inner extra leg cut) measured on the v1 low (surface-sample leg-column bbox centres): shoulder (column z 2.3), knee z 1.6, fetlock z 0.4, hoof z 0.12 (column z 0.15): +x (0.657, -0.432) (0.776, -0.354) (0.846, -0.472) (0.83, -0.654), -x (-0.433, -0.561) (-0.502, -0.571) (-0.753, -0.751) (-0.848, -0.874); points = +x, points_R = -x as generated, the repose makes them one mirror pair

chains.name: leg
chains.why: v2, shifted frame, hind legs measured on the v1 low (surface-sample leg-column bbox centres, 0.06 u slabs): hip (column z 2.3), hock z 1.6, fetlock z 0.4, hoof z 0.12 (column z 0.15): +x (0.335, 1.95) (0.352, 2.09) (0.499, 2.09) (0.594, 2.03), -x (-0.398, 2.006) (-0.46, 2.163) (-0.663, 2.244) (-0.694, 2.228); points = +x, points_R = -x as generated, the repose makes them one mirror pair. Both hind hooves float ~0.09 u (the floor contact is the extra legs, see the repose why)

chains.name: tail
chains.why: v2, shifted frame: the short upward tuft as generated (slab x-centres z 4.14 / 4.54 / 4.94: -0.16 / -0.23 / -0.26, y 2.07..2.1; root on the rump midline z 3.85): it leans 14 deg to -x (tuft mirror plane yaw 14, p99 0.093); the repose carries it onto x 0; the chain stays in the rig so it can be posed to either side

rig.spine_why: v2, shifted frame (light.yaw): hips / belly / chest on the torso plane x 0; the neck runs from the chest top (0, -0.75, 3.85; the neck slabs are centred up to z 3.9) forward-up to the head pivot; the head is NOT turned, only off-centre: face core mirror plane x -0.175 at yaw 0.0 (p99 0.041), eye centres (texture) +x (0.20, -1.99, 4.79) / -x (-0.62, -1.97, 4.80), muzzle tip x -0.17, so the head bone runs along x -0.175 heading -y and the neck yaw carries the head onto x 0 without turning it

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + height are the open artist questions): idle = breathe + the kit's tail sway; walk = a gangly calf step

_doc: LIGHT finish of the raw Pixal3D proxy (seed 56, sha d239761d). Points: stage-1 frame (Y x 0.898 side-length fit, no refloor), sheet units.

targets.why: artist 2026-10-17: symmetric rest pose; the four kept legs as two mirror-symmetric pairs at the mean (no stagger), every hoof planted
targets.radius_why: [reach, taper] per bone: the upper bones never grab the chest / belly (0.42 u), the hoof bone reaches the fringed hoof (0.55)

targets.heading: -y
targets.why: the head straight on the midline: the face is not turned (face core mirror plane yaw 0.0), only 0.175 u to -x: the neck yaws its tip onto x 0 (17.7 deg about the chest top), the head bone already heads -y, so the head translates rigidly, unturned
the tail tuft on the midline (x 0) with its as-generated side-view shape (y / z of the joints kept): a tail chain that rests centred

rigid.why: the face (muzzle, nose, mouth line, both eyes, cheeks) moves as ONE rigid body with the head bone
the crown and both tall ears ride the head bone rigidly (the ears' own asymmetry is kept as generated)

repose.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17, symmetric rest pose): after the two extra legs are cut (light.cuts), the off-centre head, the leaning tail tuft and the staggered legs are undone with BONES (proxy_finish_repose), never by mirror-averaging geometry
